tables.name: settings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "settings" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 0),
	max_concurrent_downloads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
	max_concurrent_writes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
	theme TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dark',
	default_page TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
	collapsed_navigation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	advanced_rendering INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	native_decorations INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	telemetry INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	discord_rpc INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	developer_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	onboarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	extra_launch_args JSONB NOT NULL,
	custom_env_vars JSONB NOT NULL,
	mc_memory_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2048,
	mc_force_fullscreen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	mc_game_resolution_x INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 854,
	mc_game_resolution_y INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 480,
	hide_on_process_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	hook_pre_launch TEXT NULL,
	hook_wrapper TEXT NULL,
	hook_post_exit TEXT NULL,
	custom_dir TEXT NULL,
	prev_custom_dir TEXT NULL,
	migrated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	personalized_ads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	toggle_sidebar INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	feature_flags JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
	hide_nametag_skins_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hide_nametag_skins_page IN (0, 1)),
	skipped_update TEXT NULL,
	pending_update_toast_for_version TEXT NULL,
	auto_download_updates INT NULL,
	version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	accent_color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pink',
	custom_background_path TEXT NULL,
	custom_background_blur INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12 CHECK (custom_background_blur BETWEEN 0 AND 40),
	custom_background_opacity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 65 CHECK (custom_background_opacity BETWEEN 10 AND 100),
	use_minecraft_mirror INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	use_modrinth_mirror INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	use_curseforge_mirror INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	auto_concurrent_downloads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	minecraft_metadata_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (
		minecraft_metadata_source IN ('auto', 'official_only', 'mirror_preferred', 'official_preferred')
	),
	minecraft_file_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (
		minecraft_file_source IN ('auto', 'official_only', 'mirror_preferred', 'official_preferred')
	),
	modrinth_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (
		modrinth_source IN ('auto', 'official_only', 'mirror_preferred', 'official_preferred')
	),
	curseforge_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (
		curseforge_source IN ('auto', 'official_only', 'mirror_preferred', 'official_preferred')
	),
	onboarding_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	onboarding_instance_tour_completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	sidebar_instance_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	mc_memory_auto INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	mc_memory_optimize INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	auto_set_java_high_performance_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
	transparent_background INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	transparent_background_opacity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 55,
	transparent_background_blur INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
	home_layout TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard' CHECK (home_layout IN ('standard', 'minimal')),
	minimal_home_instance_id TEXT NULL,
	auto_hide_downloads_button INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, home_widgets JSONB NULL, mojang_auth_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (
	mojang_auth_source IN ('auto', 'official_only', 'mirror_preferred', 'official_preferred')
), terracotta_public_nodes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '["wss://center.node.1tmc.top"]', telemetry_consent_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, download_engine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'xmcl', bypass_curseforge_download_restrictions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, proxy_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system'
    , proxy_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', proxy_username TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', proxy_password TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', enter_lightweight_mode_on_game_launch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, close_behavior TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ask' CHECK (
	close_behavior IN ('ask', 'close', 'lightweight')
), mc_maximize_window INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, log_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trace' CHECK (
	log_level IN ('error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug', 'trace')
), sync_features_across_devices INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, show_files_tab_in_instances INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (show_files_tab_in_instances IN (0, 1)), show_worlds_tab_in_instances INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (show_worlds_tab_in_instances IN (0, 1)), show_screenshots_tab_in_instances INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (show_screenshots_tab_in_instances IN (0, 1)), show_skin_selector_in_sidebar INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (show_skin_selector_in_sidebar IN (0, 1)), ignore_ssl_errors INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
CHECK (ignore_ssl_errors IN (0, 1)), home_widget_background_opacity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, hidden_nav_items TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', custom_window_title_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, default_window_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Minecraft', custom_background_component_opacity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, ui_font TEXT, mono_font TEXT, backup_repository_path TEXT, allow_external_scheme INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, allow_privileged_scheme INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, doh_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE
    CHECK (doh_enabled IN (0, 1)), doh_server TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'https://doh.pub/dns-query', resource_chinese_filenames INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resource_chinese_filenames IN (0, 1)), resource_preserve_filenames INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resource_preserve_filenames IN (0, 1)), curseforge_api_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', nametag_uses_app_font INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (nametag_uses_app_font IN (0, 1)), default_game_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', oobe_completed_steps TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', minecraft_use_console_java INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, force_multiconnection_downloads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, forced_max_concurrent_downloads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 72, theme_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'builtin', custom_theme_colors TEXT,
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

	project_type TEXT NOT NULL,

objects.name: resource_legacy_projects
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW resource_legacy_projects AS
SELECT DISTINCT source, project_id, content_type FROM (
    SELECT ref.provider AS source, ref.provider_project_id AS project_id, entry.project_type AS content_type
    FROM instance_content_provider_refs ref
    JOIN instance_content_entries entry ON entry.id = ref.content_entry_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT provider, provider_project_id, project_type FROM instance_pack_members
    UNION ALL
    SELECT provider, provider_project_id, project_type FROM instance_pending_manual_downloads
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source, project_id, 'modpack' FROM resource_instance_pack_projects
)
WHERE
    (source = 'modrinth' AND length(project_id) = 8 AND project_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9]*')
    OR (source = 'curseforge' AND project_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND CAST(project_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295
        AND CAST(CAST(project_id AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) = project_id)
    OR (source = 'mcarchive' AND length(project_id) = 36
        AND substr(project_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(project_id, 14, 1) = '-'
        AND substr(project_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(project_id, 24, 1) = '-'
        AND length(replace(project_id, '-', '')) = 32
        AND replace(project_id, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^a-fA-F0-9]*')
